security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'none'; worker-src 'self'

bundle.longDescription: Skidbladnir converts images to WebP and AVIF. For WebP it exposes the encoder's full control surface: modes, quality, alpha quality, compression method, segments, spatial noise shaping, filtering, target size and PSNR, multi-pass, partition limit, sharp YUV, low memory, resize and multi-threading. For AVIF: quality, alpha quality, speed, bit depth, colour model and the colour of transparent pixels.
